HomePage.hero_description: Butler. leverages Gemini AI to act as your 'Virtual Concierge'. From precision matching to guided physical inspections, we ensure you find a home, not a headache.
HomePage.feature_1_desc: Paste any URL, and our AI automatically captures and structures the listing data.
